fieldValues.title: 1. Sense: what we tried and where we went too far
fieldValues.thinking_reached:
The ideal: Nothing that matters goes unnoticed: the owner's experience is captured as it was said, and every session knows where things stand before it acts.

What we have tried: Narrative explorations and vignettes (decision 77e04b19); the clerk desk and its pinned issue; the srs-context brief and dream cycle; intake (clerk#56); the work-flow audit and the archaeology; run reports.

Problems recorded here: SP-103, SP-66, SP-61, SP-52, SP-59.
fieldValues.tensions:
- Line 1, Listen and act on what is heard: too far toward Act on it. Before 2026-10-24 agents acted on what the owner said in chat and kept only their own reading (SP-103; decision 77e04b19 corrects it).
- Line 2, Keep everything and one current picture: too far toward Keep everything. The week to 2026-10-23: 176 of 254 merged PRs were process and memory, not product (work-flow audit).
- Line 3, Many feeds and one desk: too far toward Many feeds. Five boards, nine repositories and several chats, with no single view (SP-61); sessions start without the last one's state (SP-66).
fieldValues.unresolved_questions:
- The three tensions are a first pass: none has its four 2×2 cases or the cube filled yet (handbook, A domain's axes, steps 3 and 4).
- Is each tension orthogonal to the other two in this stage, and which pole is yang here: does it flip from the parent domain?
fieldValues.next_action: Fill the 2×2 cases from the stage's own history; then name the remedy that moves us back out of each shadow.
